title: Knowing How --- the Verb That Once Meant Taste
label: ch:saber
canDo: I can say what I know how to do with sé plus an infinitive, ask someone else with sabes, and tell that apart from what poder says.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C389-saber: say one thing you know how to do with sé plus an infinitive, ask a partner the same with sabes, and say one thing you know how to do but cannot do today.
payoff.note: The payoff retrieves both Chapter-389 atoms and deliberately leaves the plural persons, the preterite supo, and saber's noun sabor for later lessons.
